articles.title: Bitcoin’s recovery stalls just short of rescuing its last underwater cohort
articles.snippet: Yearly buyer cohorts and U.S. spot ETF investors offer a map of potential support and resistance as bitcoin retreats below $84,000.

articles.title: Sui tunnels hit 40.6M TPS in live AI agent test
articles.snippet: The layer-1 blockchain said its programmable offchain tunnels reached the milestone during a live stress test designed to simulate high-frequency activity between AI agents.

articles.title: House Finance panel chair says regulator actions on crypto ‘fall short’ of CLARITY bill
articles.snippet: Representative French Hill hopes lawmakers could pass a cryptocurrency market structure bill before the next session of Congress in 2027 as SEC and CFTC actions weren’t sufficient.

articles.title: Bitcoin price drops to $82.7K October low as bond sell-off resumes on Iran nerves
articles.snippet: Bitcoin fell below $83,000 to reach month-to-date lows as stocks reversed after all-time highs and bond yields spiked higher.

articles.title: Crypto card access doesn’t match global demand, Tangem says
articles.snippet: Crypto card demand can be stronger where access is harder, Tangem says, as it expands its Visa payment offering, allowing users to spend from its self-custodial wallet.
